yale.t: Yale endorsement for US and Canadian citizens goes through the Marshall/Rhodes Common Application for Endorsement. First campus deadline was Jul 15, 2026 at 1pm (start the application and request letters); second was Jul 29, 2026 at 1pm (complete). Rhodes national deadline is Oct 7 (Canadian Sep 24). This has passed.
